sentence: This project searches for dark matter and other physics beyond the Standard Model using data from the Large Hadron Collider.
This project tries to find ways to acquire data more efficiently and use existing data more effectively for deep learning in wireless networking.
This project builds machine learning software to help scientists find the identities and quantities of proteins in a complex sample.
This project studies how daylight and the earth's magnetic field shape breeding in birds that migrate to the southern hemisphere.
This project explores how morphing origami panels made from optical metamaterials can control radiant heat in buildings.
This project studies plastics that can be tempered by heating so that one material gives a wide range of properties at room temperature.
This project develops microrobots and machine learning tools to study cellular patterns and build a liver organoid.
This project makes tellurene nanoribbons in droplet-based flow reactors to learn how they form and what controls their properties.
This project builds an instrument that monitors the energy production of T cells to judge their health before therapy.
This project studies how quantum entanglement affects hybrid quantum-classical algorithms that solve complex optimization problems.
This project tests whether DNA-derived tracers can show how snow and ice affect water flow and storage in streams.
This project studies how the embryonic environment causes lifelong effects on stress responses that pass from parents to offspring in chickens.
This project builds an observatory and models to help regions in Sub-Saharan Africa assess and respond to droughts and floods.
This project builds fiber-reinforced plastics from vitrimers that can reverse fatigue damage when heated.
This project designs ways to compress qubits and use entanglement across a network of quantum devices to improve distributed learning.
